charts.question: Feasible allocations reveal an explicit service trade-off
charts.supported_finding: Every candidate respects the same resource total and minimum block coverage before unmet demand is compared.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Modeled unmet demand is a planning quantity, not a measured service outcome under rollout.

charts.question: Demand structure is evaluated out of time
charts.supported_finding: The forecast learns from 2011 and is evaluated on 2012, preserving the direction of operational time.
charts.interpretation_boundary: System totals omit station imbalance, travel time, labor rules, and causal service response.

charts.question: The value of additional capacity is not constant
charts.supported_finding: Resource shadow values and the perfect-information upper bound show where learning or added capacity could matter.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The curve is conditional on the simplified demand and allocation model.
